text: That’s honest about what you want tonight, but don't forget that tonight is enough time to make a baby. If this girl gets pregnant, she’s gonna call you, and then what? You block her, or you agree to child support? Try to convince her to abort if she thinks abortion is killing her child? My first girlfriend, a diehard Baptist, aborted our child and told me a year later, because she “didn’t want to trap” me. I'm still shocked and saddened about that, 20 years later (assuming it was true). This is what penetrative sex can do. No contraception is perfect.
